scope: CR LF or encoded line breaks in a header value that inject extra response or request headers.
exclusions: Framing conflicts via Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding belong to http_request_smuggling
Line breaks in form text bodies with no header context
required_evidence: Raw request-target or header value containing CR LF or encoded equivalents
Response or header-set context where the injection lands
benign_counterexamples: Multiline free-text notes stored with literal newlines
Log message containing a line break in a support note
note: Seeded payload lists already cover single payload strings; write whole application scenarios instead (route, parameter, sink context), with realistic payloads of this class, at most ceil(count/families) records per family.
